Chapter 938: Chapter 5 The Eleventh-Level Citizen of the Tenth Rank of Human Civilization (Please Subscribe)

In the gloomy grand hall, more than a dozen transcendent beings of the twelfth tier were assembled.

An ultimate aura pervaded the air, and even just a twelfth-tier incarnation could unleash an extremely terrifying combat power, far surpassing Lin Yuan’s performance in the super large battlefield.

This is the twelfth tier ultimate, the life atop the universe.

“The evolutionary pathway of human civilization’s Martial Tao, after surpassing the eleventh tier, actually goes beyond the four major twelfth-tier evolutionary pathways, becoming the fifth evolutionary pathway?”

The Tianyu Clan’s ancestor spoke with a slightly grave tone, as many ultimate twelfth-tier beings rarely gather together unless it involves major events that affect the cosmic pinnacle race’s affairs.

The evolutionary pathway of Martial Tao has clearly touched the bottom line of various pinnacle races, with just the eleventh tier of the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway ranking within the top five of all human civilization’s evolutionary pathways.

What does this mean?

“It’s simply ridiculous! What exactly do the nine twelfth-tier humans of human civilization want to do, allowing a mere eleventh-tier evolutionary pathway to surpass the twelfth-tier pathways?”

A certain Queen of the Insect Race furrowed her brows, utterly disbelieving the ranking of the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway.

The so-called ranking list, isn’t it all decided by those few twelfth-tier humans? As long as they wish, even a First Tier Chapter can be placed above a twelfth-tier pathway.

But is this reality?

The gap between the eleventh tier and the twelfth tier is countless times greater than that between the first tier and eleventh tier, it’s the difference between life within the river and life outside the river.

The ultimate twelfth tier stands on the shores, theoretically with infinite lifespan, whereas eleventh-tier beings? In the eyes of the ultimate twelfth tier, they are but ants trapped in the river.

“I know Xuanyuan Xiaqin and others quite well, they would not engage in such flashy but useless actions. The advancement of the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway beyond the four grand twelfth-tier pathways must have a reason.”

The Yu Clan Ultimate slowly spoke, the first twelfth-tier Xuanyuan Supreme of human civilization sought the protection of the Yu Clan when striving for ultimacy.

Over two million years have passed, and although the Xuanyuan Supreme has long repaid the Yu Clan’s favor, he still maintains a good relationship with several of the Yu Clan’s ultimates.

The skirmishes between humans and the Yu Clan are also the least.

Of course, if it involves clan interests, killings will still occur. Lin Yuan has killed no few eleventh-tier Yu Clansmen in super large battlefields, and the Xuanyuan Supreme has not specifically hindered it.

“I agree as well.”

“There is no need for twelfth-tier humans of human civilization to ‘fabricate’ such things, it’s meaningless.”

The Supreme of the Star Alliance continued, what’s the point of forcefully pushing the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway to be the fifth evolutionary pathway of human civilization?

To show them?

If no new twelfth-tier ultimates emerge for a long time, such an act would be but a joke.

“In fact, to verify it, one only needs to observe the Martial Tao First Tier Chapter.”

The Ultimate of the Prison Tribe spoke.

At these words.

The other twelfth-tier ultimates looked at each other, not immediately responding.

All eleven pinnacle race powers have planted ‘spies’ and ‘assassins’ within human civilization, masquerading as humans and lurking.

If a remarkable evolutionary prodigy appears within human civilization, they would activate an ‘assassin’ to go for the kill.

Or if they wish to obtain some other information, they can have these ‘spies’ scout it out.

However, arranging these ‘spies’ within human civilization has cost each pinnacle race’s powers greatly; slipping past the selection of the three goddesses is no easy feat.

The subtext of the Prison Tribe Ultimate’s words was to have each pinnacle power use their ‘spies’ infiltrated in human civilization to purchase the Martial Tao First Tier Chapter.

How Martial Tao’s evolutionary pathway truly is, one only needs to see it for oneself.

Yet, to do so carries great risk, first off, to purchase the Martial Tao First Tier Chapter? It’s not something just any ‘spy’ can buy; they need at least tenth-layer strength and sufficiently high clearance.

But to arrange a tenth-tier transcendent being of another race within human civilization? The price paid is likely many times more than training an eleventh-tier powerhouse.

Such high-level ‘spies’ would definitely not be used unless necessary, any contact could lead to exposure.

“Well then.”

“I will do it.”

The Tianyu Clan’s ancestor fell silent for a moment, then began to make contact with his eyes closed.

Human civilization and the Tianyu Clan harbored deep hatred, and he too was eager to know what the Martial Tao evolutionary pathway was all about.

A moment later.

The Tianyu Clan’s ancestor opened his eyes, his expression revealing an ounce of the incomprehensible.

“What happened?”

The other twelfth-tier ultimates immediately inquired.

“Hmm?”

The expression of the Tianyu Clan’s ancestor suddenly shifted, and then quickly darkened.

Because just now, he felt that the tenth-tier Tianyu Clan member arranged within human civilization had died inexplicably, and it was the kind of death from memory contamination, beyond the possibility of revival even by reversing the flow.

“Those few twelfth-tier humans must be specifically targeting anyone who purchases the Martial Tao First Tier Chapter,” the Tianyu Clan ancestor immediately speculated.

Otherwise, the death would not have been so swift.

Even if something unusual was detected, it should be contained first, to directly kill, and moreover, a thorough kind of killing through memory contamination?

However, compared to the message left by the ‘spy’ of the Tianyu Clan before death, the Tianyu Clan ancestor didn’t have the time to be angry, instead, he looked towards the surrounding twelfth-tier ultimates and spoke directly without beating around the bush:

“The Martial Tao First Tier Chapter is not simple; it contains thousands of rule models that incorporate fusion rules, along with complete models of the rules from the First Realm to the Fifth Realm of spacetime.”

The Tianyu Clan ancestor spoke gravely.

“Thousands of models that incorporate fusion rules?”

“Complete spacetime First Realm to Fifth Realm rule models?”
